judge.rationale: The candidate ignored almost every specific requirement in the issue and invented its own API names and semantics. It implemented `list_sessions` and `session_list` instead of `list_conversations` and `conversation_list`, and named the types `ListSessionsMessage` / `SessionListMessage` / `SessionSummaryFrame` instead of `ListConversationsMessage` / `ConversationListMessage` / `ConversationSummary`. It completely omitted the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in config, the `UNSUPPORTED` error code, and `StoreCannotList`, and explicitly returned an empty list when `listFor` is missing despite the issue repeatedly stating that doing so is a bug and must return an `UNSUPPORTED` error instead. Furthermore, its validator allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` (violating the 1–200 acceptance criterion), it logs `error.message` on store failure (violating the requirement not to leak store details), and it missed updating `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, and `docs/getting-started.md` as well as leaving `.lore/dod.md` committed in the tree.
